title: Secrecy briefing at Kilo control and ostracism after the incident
summary: Mario Woods tells of Secrecy briefing at Kilo control and ostracism after the incident, about November 1977 at Kilo control, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Kilo control, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Well, when I was sent to KE control, I got a real strict briefing from Master Sergeant Gray

plain: A former US Air Force man named Mario Woods says that in November 1977, after a strange incident in the nuclear missile fields around Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he was sent to Kilo control, one of the posts that oversee those missiles. There, he says, a Master Sergeant Gray gave him a very strict briefing to keep quiet, and a Colonel Spreer also figures in his account. He says he was shunned by others afterward, which he presents as a sign the incident was being hushed up.
